superseded_packet_sentence: The fibre of transverse oriented periods is the connected component D+ of three-planes F in C6 satisfying F direct-sum conjugate(F)=C6 whose induced real orientation agrees with the supplied orientation; the representation acts by its actual real linear maps. A period family is a holomorphic section of the associated D+ bundle.
corrected_definition: The transverse periods are three-planes F in C6 satisfying F direct-sum conjugate(F)=C6; the representation acts by its actual real linear maps. F3.8 defines D3 to be the component containing the standard complex structure, and F3.9 explicitly asks for its associated D3 bundle. F3.11 itself does not state a preassigned component or name D3. For a chosen real cusp normalizer P, the actual coordinate map is F=P F_standard, so the cusp construction is transported from D3 to P D3. This packet imposes no extra requirement that P have positive determinant. A period family here is a holomorphic transverse section in the component specified by that actual cusp marking.
